title: 推拿總論與手法要求
titleEn: Tuina principles: persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating

stages.title: 第一節 · 機制與病理生理（免費試學）

steps.title: 機制與病理生理
steps.objective: 掌握推拿總論與手法要求的背景與基本機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Grasp the background and basic mechanism of Tuina principles: persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating.
steps.instruction: 閱讀並整理：持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透；練功（沙袋、米袋）。
steps.instructionEn: Read and organise: The five qualities and practice on sandbags.
steps.observation: 以流程圖畫出因果鏈。
steps.observationEn: Draw the causal chain as a flow diagram.
steps.failure: 把相關性誤認為因果是最常見的推理錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: 持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透；練功（沙袋、米袋）。
knowledge.textEn: The five qualities and practice on sandbags.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

quiz.question: 「機制與病理生理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Mechanism and pathophysiology'?
options: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
已正確完成「有力」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「持久」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
'practice on sandbags' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'The five qualities' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵名詞與分類
steps.objective: 建立本題的名詞表與分類架構。
steps.objectiveEn: Build the glossary and classification for this topic.
steps.instruction: 列出 8–12 個關鍵名詞，各以一句話定義，並以表格呈現分類。
steps.instructionEn: List 8–12 key terms with one-sentence definitions and tabulate the classification.
steps.observation: 完成名詞表。
steps.observationEn: Complete the glossary.
steps.failure: 名詞混用會導致後續判斷錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mixing terms leads to later misjudgement.
steps.check: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
steps.checkEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.

knowledge.title: 分類的目的
knowledge.text: 分類應服務於治療決策或預後。
knowledge.textEn: Classification should serve treatment decisions or prognosis.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key terms and classification'?

能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.

The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.

stages.title: 第二節 · 臨床表現與診斷

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：持久
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「持久」在推拿總論與手法要求中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'The five qualities' within Tuina principles: persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「持久」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'The five qualities': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「持久」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'The five qualities'.
steps.failure: 若「持久」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'The five qualities' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「持久」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'The five qualities' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「持久」是推拿總論與手法要求的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'The five qualities' is a core component of Tuina principles: persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

stages.title: 第三節 · 治療與實證

steps.title: 治療與實證
steps.objective: 整合治療原則、證據等級與現代意義。
steps.objectiveEn: Integrate treatment principles, evidence levels and modern relevance.
steps.instruction: 列出一線與二線做法、支持證據（試驗／指引／經典條文）與限制。
steps.instructionEn: List first- and second-line approaches, supporting evidence (trials/guidelines/classical passages) and limitations.
steps.observation: 寫一段 150 字總結。
steps.observationEn: Write a 150-word summary.
steps.failure: 證據等級與推薦強度不可混淆。
steps.failureEn: Evidence level and recommendation strength are not the same thing.
steps.check: 總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
steps.checkEn: The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.

knowledge.title: 證據金字塔
knowledge.text: 系統性回顧與 RCT 位於頂端，專家意見在底層。
knowledge.textEn: Systematic reviews and RCTs sit at the top; expert opinion at the bottom.

steps.title: 病例應用與自我測驗
steps.objective: 以一個病例或情境應用本題。
steps.objectiveEn: Apply the topic to a case or scenario.
steps.instruction: 描述情境→列出鑑別→選擇處置→預測結果→比較實際。
steps.instructionEn: Describe the scenario → list differentials → choose management → predict outcome → compare with reality.
steps.observation: 完成病例紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Complete the case record.
steps.failure: 跳過鑑別診斷直接下結論是危險的捷徑。
steps.failureEn: Skipping the differential is a dangerous shortcut.
steps.check: 病例推理完整。
steps.checkEn: Case reasoning complete.

knowledge.title: 反思
knowledge.text: 每個病例都應回答：我學到什麼、下次會怎麼做。
knowledge.textEn: Every case should answer: what did I learn, what will I do differently.

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解按法的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Pressing.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：指按、掌按與肘按；用於腧穴與肌肉。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Finger, palm and elbow pressing on points and muscles.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

quiz.question: 「手法要領與原理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Essentials and principles of the technique'?
options: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
流程合理且含評估與再評估。
能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
optionsEn: Safety screening and consent complete.
Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.
Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。
steps.instructionEn: Screen contraindications (fracture, thrombosis, infection, pregnancy, implants), explain pressure and obtain consent.
steps.observation: 記錄受術者回饋。
steps.observationEn: Record the recipient's feedback.
steps.failure: 忽略禁忌是推拿事故的主因。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.title: 人體力學
knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。
knowledge.textEn: Drive with body weight and legs to protect the practitioner's wrists and back.

quiz.question: 「施術者姿勢與安全溝通」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

完成安全篩檢與同意。
流程合理且含評估與再評估。
optionsEn: 'elbow pressing on points' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
Safety screening and consent complete.
Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objectiveEn: Build stable rhythm and endurance on a practice bag.
steps.instruction: 每日 10 分鐘，以節拍器維持規定頻率，逐週增加時間。

steps.failureEn: An unstable rhythm means the movement pattern is not yet set.
steps.check: 能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
steps.checkEn: Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.

knowledge.title: 頻率參考

stages.title: 第三節 · 臨床應用與禁忌

steps.title: 臨床應用與配伍
steps.objective: 將手法置入治療序列。
steps.objectiveEn: Place the technique within a treatment sequence.
steps.instruction: 依病症選擇準備手法→主要手法→結束手法，並與穴位配合。
steps.instructionEn: Choose preparatory → main → finishing techniques for the condition and combine with points.
steps.observation: 寫出一份 20 分鐘的治療流程。
steps.observationEn: Write a 20-minute treatment sequence.
steps.failure: 直接以重手法開始會引起防禦性緊張。
steps.failureEn: Starting with heavy techniques provokes guarding.
steps.check: 流程合理且含評估與再評估。
steps.checkEn: Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.

knowledge.title: 再評估
knowledge.text: 每次治療前後比較活動度與疼痛分數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare range of motion and pain score before and after each session.

steps.title: 禁忌、風險與紀錄
steps.objective: 列出手法的禁忌與不良反應。
steps.objectiveEn: List contraindications and adverse effects.
steps.instruction: 整理絕對／相對禁忌、常見不適（瘀青、酸痛）與處理，完成治療紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compile absolute/relative contraindications, common reactions (bruising, soreness) and management; complete the record.
steps.observation: 紀錄包含部位、手法、時間、反應。
steps.observationEn: Records include region, techniques, duration and response.
steps.failure: 頸椎扳法等高風險手法必須有明確適應症與訓練。
steps.failureEn: High-risk techniques such as cervical thrust require clear indications and training.
steps.check: 紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。
steps.checkEn: Record complete and three contraindications named.

knowledge.title: 通報

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解揉法的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Kneading.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：指揉、掌揉、魚際揉；頻率 120–160 次／分。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Finger, palm and thenar kneading at 120–160/min.

steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.textEn: 'thoracic counter-thrust' is a core component of Pulling/thrusting; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：腰椎斜扳」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: thoracic counter-thrust'?
options: 能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
已正確完成「頸椎斜扳」並以文字或數據留下證據。
完成安全篩檢與同意。
已正確完成「腰椎斜扳」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
'Cervical/lumbar oblique thrusts' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Safety screening and consent complete.
'thoracic counter-thrust' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 3：胸椎對抗復位
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「胸椎對抗復位」在扳法中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'contraindications' within Pulling/thrusting, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 練習「胸椎對抗復位」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Practise 'contraindications': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「胸椎對抗復位」的力度（輕／中／重）、頻率與時間。
steps.observationEn: Record pressure (light/medium/firm), rhythm and duration for 'contraindications'.
steps.failure: 若「胸椎對抗復位」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'contraindications' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「胸椎對抗復位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'contraindications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「胸椎對抗復位」是扳法的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'contraindications' is a core component of Pulling/thrusting; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 3：胸椎對抗復位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。

Safety screening and consent complete.
'contraindications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 沙袋／米袋練功與節奏
steps.objective: 在練功袋上建立穩定節奏與耐力。
steps.objectiveEn: Build stable rhythm and endurance on a practice bag.
steps.instruction: 每日 10 分鐘，以節拍器維持規定頻率，逐週增加時間。
steps.instructionEn: Ten minutes daily at the prescribed rate with a metronome, increasing weekly.
steps.observation: 記錄可持續時間與疲勞部位。
steps.observationEn: Record sustainable duration and fatigue sites.
steps.failure: 節奏不穩代表動作結構未定型。
steps.failureEn: An unstable rhythm means the movement pattern is not yet set.
steps.check: 能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
steps.checkEn: Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.

knowledge.title: 頻率參考
knowledge.textEn: Kneading 120–160/min, rolling about 140/min, one-finger pushing 120–160/min.

quiz.question: 「沙袋／米袋練功與節奏」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Sandbag practice and rhythm'?
options: 已正確完成「腰椎斜扳」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
已正確完成「頸椎斜扳」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
optionsEn: 'thoracic counter-thrust' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
'Cervical/lumbar oblique thrusts' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 臨床應用與禁忌

steps.title: 臨床應用與配伍
steps.objective: 將手法置入治療序列。
steps.objectiveEn: Place the technique within a treatment sequence.
steps.instruction: 依病症選擇準備手法→主要手法→結束手法，並與穴位配合。
steps.instructionEn: Choose preparatory → main → finishing techniques for the condition and combine with points.
steps.observation: 寫出一份 20 分鐘的治療流程。
steps.observationEn: Write a 20-minute treatment sequence.
steps.failure: 直接以重手法開始會引起防禦性緊張。
steps.failureEn: Starting with heavy techniques provokes guarding.
steps.check: 流程合理且含評估與再評估。
steps.checkEn: Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.

knowledge.title: 再評估
knowledge.text: 每次治療前後比較活動度與疼痛分數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare range of motion and pain score before and after each session.

quiz.question: 「臨床應用與配伍」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Clinical application and combinations'?
options: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
流程合理且含評估與再評估。
紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。
能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
optionsEn: Safety screening and consent complete.
Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.
Record complete and three contraindications named.
Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 禁忌、風險與紀錄
steps.objective: 列出手法的禁忌與不良反應。
steps.objectiveEn: List contraindications and adverse effects.
steps.instruction: 整理絕對／相對禁忌、常見不適（瘀青、酸痛）與處理，完成治療紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compile absolute/relative contraindications, common reactions (bruising, soreness) and management; complete the record.
steps.observation: 紀錄包含部位、手法、時間、反應。
steps.observationEn: Records include region, techniques, duration and response.
steps.failure: 頸椎扳法等高風險手法必須有明確適應症與訓練。
steps.failureEn: High-risk techniques such as cervical thrust require clear indications and training.
steps.check: 紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。
steps.checkEn: Record complete and three contraindications named.

knowledge.title: 通報
knowledge.text: 異常反應應通報並檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Adverse reactions should be reported and reviewed.

quiz.question: 「禁忌、風險與紀錄」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。
optionsEn: Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.
'contraindications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'thoracic counter-thrust' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Record complete and three contraindications named.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解拔伸法的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Traction.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：頸椎、腰椎與指關節拔伸。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Cervical, lumbar and finger traction.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

quiz.question: 「手法要領與原理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Essentials and principles of the technique'?
options: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
已正確完成「腰椎與指關節拔伸」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「頸椎」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Safety screening and consent complete.
Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
'lumbar and finger traction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Cervical' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。
steps.instructionEn: Screen contraindications (fracture, thrombosis, infection, pregnancy, implants), explain pressure and obtain consent.
steps.observation: 記錄受術者回饋。
steps.observationEn: Record the recipient's feedback.
steps.failure: 忽略禁忌是推拿事故的主因。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.title: 人體力學
knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。
knowledge.textEn: Drive with body weight and legs to protect the practitioner's wrists and back.

quiz.question: 「施術者姿勢與安全溝通」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Practitioner posture and safe communication'?
options: 已正確完成「頸椎」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
完成安全篩檢與同意。
紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。
optionsEn: 'Cervical' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
Safety screening and consent complete.
Record complete and three contraindications named.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 推拿治療腰痛與椎間盤突出
titleEn: Tuina for low back pain and disc herniation

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解推拿治療腰痛與椎間盤突出的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Tuina for low back pain and disc herniation.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：腰部滾法、按揉腎俞、斜扳與牽引。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Lumbar rolling, BL23 kneading, oblique thrust and traction.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

quiz.question: 「手法要領與原理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
optionsEn: 'Lumbar rolling' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'oblique thrust and traction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.
Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。
steps.instructionEn: Screen contraindications (fracture, thrombosis, infection, pregnancy, implants), explain pressure and obtain consent.
steps.observation: 記錄受術者回饋。
steps.observationEn: Record the recipient's feedback.
steps.failure: 忽略禁忌是推拿事故的主因。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.title: 人體力學
knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。
knowledge.textEn: Drive with body weight and legs to protect the practitioner's wrists and back.

optionsEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

'Lumbar rolling' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解推拿治療肩周炎的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Tuina for frozen shoulder.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：鬆解、搖肩、扳肩與功能鍛鍊。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Release, rotation, thrust and exercises.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

quiz.question: 「手法要領與原理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

完成安全篩檢與同意。
optionsEn: 'thrust and exercises' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'rotation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
Safety screening and consent complete.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。
steps.instructionEn: Screen contraindications (fracture, thrombosis, infection, pregnancy, implants), explain pressure and obtain consent.
steps.observation: 記錄受術者回饋。
steps.observationEn: Record the recipient's feedback.
steps.failure: 忽略禁忌是推拿事故的主因。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.title: 人體力學
knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。

steps.objective: 能說明並執行「鬆解」在推拿治療肩周炎中的作用與順序。

steps.instruction: 練習「鬆解」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。

steps.checkEn: 'Release' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

steps.instruction: 依病症選擇準備手法→主要手法→結束手法，並與穴位配合。

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解小兒推拿退熱的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Paediatric tuina for fever.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：清天河水、退六腑、推脊。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Clearing tianheshui, pushing down liufu and spinal pushing.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。

steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。

steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

title: 小兒推拿治積滯與泄瀉
titleEn: Paediatric tuina for food stagnation and diarrhoea

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解小兒推拿治積滯與泄瀉的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Paediatric tuina for food stagnation and diarrhoea.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：補脾經、摩腹、揉板門、捏脊。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Tonifying spleen channel, abdominal rubbing, banmen kneading and spinal pinching.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。

steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。

steps.checkEn: 'The eight bone-setting methods from Yizong Jinjian' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「摸接端提按摩推拿」是正骨手法概論的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'The eight bone-setting methods from Yizong Jinjian' is a core component of Bone-setting fundamentals; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：摸接端提按摩推拿」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。

Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
'The eight bone-setting methods from Yizong Jinjian' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 沙袋／米袋練功與節奏
steps.objective: 在練功袋上建立穩定節奏與耐力。
steps.objectiveEn: Build stable rhythm and endurance on a practice bag.
steps.instruction: 每日 10 分鐘，以節拍器維持規定頻率，逐週增加時間。
steps.instructionEn: Ten minutes daily at the prescribed rate with a metronome, increasing weekly.
steps.observation: 記錄可持續時間與疲勞部位。
steps.observationEn: Record sustainable duration and fatigue sites.
steps.failure: 節奏不穩代表動作結構未定型。
steps.failureEn: An unstable rhythm means the movement pattern is not yet set.
steps.check: 能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
steps.checkEn: Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.

knowledge.title: 頻率參考
knowledge.textEn: Kneading 120–160/min, rolling about 140/min, one-finger pushing 120–160/min.

steps.objective: 將手法置入治療序列。

steps.instruction: 依病症選擇準備手法→主要手法→結束手法，並與穴位配合。

steps.check: 流程合理且含評估與再評估。
steps.checkEn: Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.

stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解自我按摩與保健推拿的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Self-massage and health-maintenance tuina.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

steps.objectiveEn: Place the technique within a treatment sequence.
steps.instruction: 依病症選擇準備手法→主要手法→結束手法，並與穴位配合。
steps.instructionEn: Choose preparatory → main → finishing techniques for the condition and combine with points.
steps.observation: 寫出一份 20 分鐘的治療流程。

steps.failure: 直接以重手法開始會引起防禦性緊張。
steps.failureEn: Starting with heavy techniques provokes guarding.
steps.check: 流程合理且含評估與再評估。

knowledge.title: 再評估
knowledge.text: 每次治療前後比較活動度與疼痛分數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare range of motion and pain score before and after each session.

stages.title: 第一節 · 手法要領（免費試學）
stages.description: 跟師傅學：示範、原理與安全。
stages.descriptionEn: Learn from the master: demonstration, principle and safety.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解足部反射區按摩的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Foot reflexology.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：反射區圖、手法與禁忌。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Reflex zone maps, techniques and contraindications.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

quiz.question: 「手法要領與原理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

完成安全篩檢與同意。
流程合理且含評估與再評估。
optionsEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
Record complete and three contraindications named.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。
steps.instructionEn: Screen contraindications (fracture, thrombosis, infection, pregnancy, implants), explain pressure and obtain consent.
steps.observation: 記錄受術者回饋。
steps.observationEn: Record the recipient's feedback.
steps.failure: 忽略禁忌是推拿事故的主因。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.title: 人體力學
knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。
knowledge.textEn: Drive with body weight and legs to protect the practitioner's wrists and back.

quiz.question: 「施術者姿勢與安全溝通」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作練習

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：反射區圖
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「反射區圖」在足部反射區按摩中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Reflex zone maps' within Foot reflexology, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 練習「反射區圖」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Practise 'Reflex zone maps': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「反射區圖」的力度（輕／中／重）、頻率與時間。
steps.observationEn: Record pressure (light/medium/firm), rhythm and duration for 'Reflex zone maps'.
steps.failure: 若「反射區圖」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Reflex zone maps' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「反射區圖」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Reflex zone maps' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「反射區圖」是足部反射區按摩的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Reflex zone maps' is a core component of Foot reflexology; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

已正確完成「反射區圖」並以文字或數據留下證據。
完成安全篩檢與同意。
流程合理且含評估與再評估。
optionsEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
'Reflex zone maps' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

steps.title: 沙袋／米袋練功與節奏
steps.objective: 在練功袋上建立穩定節奏與耐力。
steps.objectiveEn: Build stable rhythm and endurance on a practice bag.
steps.instruction: 每日 10 分鐘，以節拍器維持規定頻率，逐週增加時間。
steps.instructionEn: Ten minutes daily at the prescribed rate with a metronome, increasing weekly.
steps.observation: 記錄可持續時間與疲勞部位。
steps.observationEn: Record sustainable duration and fatigue sites.
steps.failure: 節奏不穩代表動作結構未定型。
steps.failureEn: An unstable rhythm means the movement pattern is not yet set.
steps.check: 能連續施術 5 分鐘且節奏均勻。
steps.checkEn: Can perform continuously for five minutes with an even rhythm.

knowledge.title: 頻率參考
knowledge.textEn: Kneading 120–160/min, rolling about 140/min, one-finger pushing 120–160/min.

steps.title: 臨床應用與配伍
steps.objective: 將手法置入治療序列。
steps.objectiveEn: Place the technique within a treatment sequence.
steps.instruction: 依病症選擇準備手法→主要手法→結束手法，並與穴位配合。
steps.instructionEn: Choose preparatory → main → finishing techniques for the condition and combine with points.
steps.observation: 寫出一份 20 分鐘的治療流程。
steps.observationEn: Write a 20-minute treatment sequence.
steps.failure: 直接以重手法開始會引起防禦性緊張。
steps.failureEn: Starting with heavy techniques provokes guarding.
steps.check: 流程合理且含評估與再評估。
steps.checkEn: Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.

knowledge.title: 再評估
knowledge.text: 每次治療前後比較活動度與疼痛分數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare range of motion and pain score before and after each session.
